description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and BPC (bits per character) for two validation methods. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps (x10³)” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled “BPC” and has a linear scale ranging from 1.2 to 2.2, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2.  A black line with circular markers represents “SMoE Validating”; starting at approximately (0, 1.64), it declines to approximately (10, 1.28), then fluctuates between approximately 1.17 and 1.26 from (20, 1.22) to (50, 1.18). A magenta line with no markers represents “SimSMoE Validating”; starting at approximately (0, 2.12), this line declines to approximately (10, 1.28) and then fluctuates between approximately 1.17 and 1.26 from (20, 1.22) to (50, 1.24).
